lesson.subtitle: Lesson 10 -- Are Public Schools Ready for AI?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 10 -- Are Public Schools Ready for AI?

listenings.text: Hi Joice, this is Marta, the principal of Vila Mariana school. We have some tablets, but not enough for nine hundred students. Our teachers want to use AI, but only five teachers have any training. How much time do they need? And we don't have any rules about student data. Can you help us? Can we talk on Friday?

extra_audio.text: Marta is the principal of a public school in São Paulo. Her school has some tablets, but not enough for the students. Only five teachers have any training in AI. Marta sends a message to Joice. Joice and Marta talk on Friday about teacher training.
